blocks.text: Jab matloob capacitance hasil karne ke liye aik se zyada capacitors circuit mein jore jayein to majmua aik barabar (equivalent) capacitor ki tarah bartao karta hai; is ki capacitance combined capacitance hai. Do aam majmue parallel aur series hain.

Parallel mein har capacitor ki aik plate battery ke manfi terminal se aur doosri plate musbat terminal se juri hoti hai (Fig 16.8). Har capacitor par potential difference V aik jaisa hai, lekin har aik ka charge us ki capacitance par munhasir hai. Kul charge Q = Q1 + Q2 + Q3. Q1 = C1 V, Q2 = C2 V, Q3 = C3 V aur Q = Ce V se: Ce V = C1 V + C2 V + C3 V, is liye Ce = C1 + C2 + C3 (16.35). Parallel mein jure capacitors ki combined capacitance un ki alag capacitances ka jor hai.

80 pF capacitor 48 V tak charge kiya jata hai. Phir use aik be-charge capacitor se parallel mein jora jata hai, aur majmue par potential difference 30 V ho jata hai. Doosre capacitor ki capacitance maloom karein. Hal: pehle charge Q1 = C1 V1 = (80 x 10^-12 F)(48 V) = 3840 x 10^-12 C. Baad mein C1 par bacha charge (80 x 10^-12 F)(30 V) = 2400 x 10^-12 C. Charge mehfooz rehta hai, is liye C2 par gaya charge 3840 - 2400 = 1440 x 10^-12 C, aur C2 = Q2 / V = 1440 x 10^-12 C / 30 V = 48 x 10^-12 F = 48 pF.

Series mein capacitors aik ke baad aik jore jate hain (Fig 16.9 a): C1 ki doosri plate C2 ki pehli plate se juri, waghera, aur C1 ki pehli plate aur C3 ki aakhri plate battery se juri. Battery C1 ki pehli plate ko +Q deti hai, jo us ki doosri plate par -Q paida karta hai; kyunke woh plate C2 ki pehli plate se juri hai, wahan +Q aata hai, waghera. Yun har capacitor par barabar miqdar Q ka charge hota hai. Majmue par potential difference battery voltage ke barabar hai, lekin yeh bat jata hai: V = V1 + V2 + V3 (16.36). V = Q/Ce, V1 = Q/C1, V2 = Q/C2, V3 = Q/C3 se: Q/Ce = Q/C1 + Q/C2 + Q/C3, is liye 1/Ce = 1/C1 + 1/C2 + 1/C3 (16.37). Equivalent capacitance ka ulat alag capacitances ke ulton ka jor hai; Ce series ki sab se chhoti capacitance se bhi kam hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: teen capacitors C1, C2 aur C3 battery ke aar-paar aik hi do taron ke darmiyan parallel mein; Q = Q1 + Q2 + Q3 aur Ce = C1 + C2 + C3. Daen: teen capacitors C1, C2 aur C3 battery ke saath aik hi chakkar mein aik ke baad aik; V = V1 + V2 + V3 aur 1/Ce = 1/C1 + 1/C2 + 1/C3.
blocks.caption: Parallel aur series mein capacitors (Figs 16.8 aur 16.9 ke mutabiq asal circuit khaake).
blocks.long_description: Parallel mein capacitors ka voltage aik aur charges jurte hain, is liye capacitances jurti hain. Series mein charge aik aur voltages jurte hain, is liye ulat jurte hain.

blocks.text: 12 uF aur 4 uF ke capacitors 80 V battery se series mein jore gaye hain. (i) kul jama charge aur (ii) har aik par potential difference maloom karein. Hal: 1/Ce = 1/12 + 1/4 = (1 + 3)/12 = 1/3, is liye Ce = 3 uF. (i) Q = Ce V = (3 x 10^-6 F)(80 V) = 2.4 x 10^-4 C. (ii) Har aik par wahi Q: V1 = Q/C1 = 2.4 x 10^-4 / 12 x 10^-6 = 20 V aur V2 = Q/C2 = 2.4 x 10^-4 / 4 x 10^-6 = 60 V (20 V + 60 V = 80 V).

blocks.prompt: Do 6 uF capacitors dastyab hain. In se kaun si capacitances banayi ja sakti hain?
blocks.explanation: 6 uF (aik akela), 12 uF (dono parallel mein) aur 3 uF (dono series mein).

items: Parallel: V aik; Ce = C1 + C2 + C3.
Series: Q aik; V = V1 + V2 + V3; 1/Ce = 1/C1 + 1/C2 + 1/C3.
Charged capacitors jorne par charge mehfooz rehta.
